svg.title: Linux VRF L3 Master Device isolation: ARP, routing, and socket
svg.desc: Diagram showing how Linux VRF uses L3 Master Device to isolate ARP tables, routing tables, and sockets across two VRF instances inside a single network namespace.
svg.text: net.vrf.strict_mode=1 → unbound sockets cannot receive packets from any VRF interface
strict_mode=0 (default) → global sockets may still "leak" receive VRF traffic (legacy compat)
